entries.basis: WCO HS 2022 heading 39.21 contains named cellular subheadings 3921.11–3921.19 and residual subheading 3921.90 ('Other'). The residual aggregates heterogeneous reinforced, laminated, supported or similarly combined plastic sheet products and does not resolve a product-specific decision object.
